findings.trigger: Use an original production candidate whose cross-split duplicates require the registered210-to20 selection, or use the derived final20 manifest directly.
facts: candidate status==valid is required before reading selection. Original reviewed162 has cross_split_similarity=false and status=invalid. Adding execute-only rows does not delete its existing cross-split violation pairs.
extract_registration still calls build_artifacts on all extracted rows and has no selection argument. reproduced must equal candidate before any row selection.

Current final210 has20 rows, source_registration_sha256 absent, invalid execute coverage and no regression fingerprint. It fails status first; merely fixing status would next fail source identity/reproduction.
Thus exact waiver forwarding is a real improvement, but moving no membership logic into re-extraction means existing dedup policy is not reproducible as the effective candidate audit.
findings.impact: The stated210-to20 dedup path remains blocked even after execute coverage is repaired; it cannot use row_selection to repair raw cross-split similarity while preserving exact audit equality.
findings.repair_requirement: Reproduce the registered policy from verified source rows, audit the selected effective set under unchanged thresholds, and compare its full provenance/membership audit with the registered effective candidate; do not hand-flip raw status or bypass exact checks.

findings.trigger: A valid raw candidate has multiple dev/confirmation rows, and row_selection drops at least one while retaining nonempty declared splits.
facts: Selection verifies IDs and selected split counts, then replaces all_rows with selected_rows.
Only selected train rows are written, but regression_candidate.json is copied unchanged from raw extraction.
Dataset counts reflect selected dev/confirmation membership while regression file and fingerprint still represent raw dev/confirmation membership. No check forbids dropping regression IDs.
admit_dataset hashes regression and normalizes train only; it does not compare regression membership/counts with selection.
findings.impact: Frozen train and reported counts can describe a different selection from actual regression. This also violates intended immutable fixed-regression semantics when a selection attempts to exclude existing anchors.
findings.repair_requirement: Either require exact preservation of all pinned regression members and derive selected counts accordingly, or, for first freeze only, build/fingerprint the effective regression from the selected audited rows. Reuse must never silently change regression membership.

findings.trigger: Raw candidate passes required coverage; selected IDs omit the only row carrying execute or another preregistered flag, but retained split counts meet minimum.
facts: Policy evidence refs are only hash-verified; content is not recomputed or semantically checked. _read_selection does not use its candidate parameter.
No build_artifacts/coverage/similarity quality recomputation occurs after selected_rows replaces all_rows.
candidate_audit in frozen manifest remains the raw audit with its passing gates, while training and counts describe the subset.
findings.impact: An effective dataset lacking required execute coverage could freeze and later admit under stale raw passing coverage. Passing raw coverage does not imply subset coverage.
findings.repair_requirement: Evaluate required coverage and applicable quality gates on the actual selected train+fixed-regression set, and bind that audit into the frozen manifest; exact policy bytes alone are not proof the chosen subset passes gates.

positive_facts: Registration waiver SHA must match candidate admission SHA in both directions; read_equivalence_waiver is invoked and exact mapping/SHA forwarded to re-extraction.
Selection rejects duplicate/missing IDs and split-count mismatch; it filters existing rows without editing their contents.
Initial freeze still allows prior_regression=None; absence of prior triple pins is not a first-freeze circular ban.
test_scope: New selection tests mock extract_registration to return an already-valid candidate; the mocked regression file is only {unit_test_only:true}.

They demonstrate train ID filtering and counts, but cannot demonstrate raw-invalid dedup admission, selected regression identity or post-selection coverage preservation. No tests executed in this review.
authorization_and_execution: No training, optimizer smoke, freezing, model calls, source edits, historical evidence changes or Holdout reads. Existing Agent low score is not the reason for blocking training; real data/freeze gates are.
